summary: stui context menus expose existing row, message and top-bar actions with keyboard access in both layouts.

replay.detail: UI-only change; no claim replay or projection rebuild is added.

schema.detail: No database tables, indexes, triggers or migrations change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, digests or fleet coordination requirements change.

compatibility.detail: Menus reuse existing actions and the existing optional in_reply_to message field. The shared World and client-v0 schema are unchanged; terminal bodies retain program right-clicks.

downtime.detail: The stui-only change adds no daemon restart, API interruption or recovery wait.

manual.detail: No manual action or configuration change is required.

recovery.detail: No new recovery or rollback step is required; this change introduces no stored state transition.
